name: zdeclient_feature_system_lifecycle
description: zDEClient feature-entry vector and feature map-tree lifecycle initialization and shutdown.
known_limits: Tier S is deferred to the zDEClient feature map lifecycle pass. The authored source preserves the recovered lifecycle state and restores the provider-owned std::_Lockit guard trigger, but stack-byte initialization shape is not yet byte-accepted.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457cc0 validates mode/flags byte copy, shared nil-node allocation, ref-count increment, header allocation, and node-count reset.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4576e0 validates erase-range cleanup, header delete, shared nil ref-count decrement, and nil delete at zero refs.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457660, 0x4576a0, 0x4576b0, and 0x457650 validates feature vector init, atexit registration, shutdown cleanup, and the top-level init call chain.

The native lifecycle smoke verifies InitState header/nil shape, insertion through the recovered map-tree helper, Destroy cleanup, feature vector initialization, populated tree shutdown, and shared nil ref-count release.
